what: one JTAG mem_ap read of the carrier STATUS window, taken while the A9 was already stalled by the calibration of evidence/calibration_noop_2026_08_12d
result: Timeout during WAIT recovery / Failed to read memory at 0x43c02004
what_it_does_NOT_show: The A9 was ALREADY stalled with an outstanding transaction on the same GP0 port when this probe ran, so the timeout does not establish that the carrier slave itself is the silent source: an existing A9 transaction can hold the shared GP0 downstream. This record exists to preserve the measurement, not that inference.
side_effect: A FAILED mem_ap probe leaves the AHB-AP with an outstanding transaction; later arp_examine raises JTAG-DP STICKY ERROR until a power cycle. This spent that budget.
